resources.string: Trial is OFF. Enable it in settings on both PC and phone.
Detection is not yet verified in this environment.

Connect over the same Wi-Fi or Tailscale. For remote access, install Tailscale on both devices, connect with the same Tailscale account and register the pairing code for the PC 100.x address. Sign in to GPT HUD with the same ChatGPT account on both devices and enable the trial. This screen checks every 15 seconds while open; the interval does not continue with only a home widget or the screen off. Read-only logs detect new turn start, completion and interruption after observation starts. Approval/input waits and turn failures are not inferred. Turn completion is not project completion. Widgets show last contact and last known state. Losing contact does not imply task failure. Existing Wi-Fi history-sharing schedules remain unchanged.
